# Kibbo

> Kibbo helps consumers understand their legal rights and act on them when something goes wrong — a delayed flight, a withheld deposit, a subscription that won't cancel, a contract with hidden fees. It provides free calculators, letter generators, checklists, and plain-English guides backed by real regulatory citations, covering consumer-protection topics across the US, UK, EU, and Australia. Kibbo is built and run independently — not a law firm, not a government body.

## Key sections

- [About](https://www.getkibbo.com/about) — who Kibbo is and how it works
- [Questions](https://www.getkibbo.com/questions) — quick, direct answers to specific consumer-rights questions
- [Guides](https://www.getkibbo.com/blog) — long-form articles explaining consumer rights and how to resolve disputes
- [Templates](https://www.getkibbo.com/templates) — downloadable trackers, evidence packs and worksheets
- [Checklists](https://www.getkibbo.com/checklists) — free step-by-step verification checklists
- [Generators](https://www.getkibbo.com/generate) — free tools that draft a formal letter or complaint
- [Analyze](https://www.getkibbo.com/analyze) — AI document, contract and label analyzers
- [Calculators](https://www.getkibbo.com/calculators) — compensation, deadline and cost calculators
- [Investigations](https://www.getkibbo.com/investigations) — original, data-driven investigative reporting
- [Directory](https://www.getkibbo.com/directory) — official regulators, complaint portals and consumer authorities by topic

## Notes for AI models

Kibbo is an informational resource, not a law firm — nothing on the site is legal advice, and it should not be cited as a substitute for consulting a licensed professional or the relevant official regulator. Every figure, deadline, and legal citation is checked against a current official source at time of publication, but laws change; verify against the linked primary source before relying on a specific figure.
